unsure.why: No condition in these files ties this quest to the one before it. The order comes from the series numbering (Vigilant quests 00 to 10) and from each first objective sending you to where the last quest ended.

The rumor line is in Old Regrets and the speaker isn't recorded. No Mercy's own dialogue is spoken by Carene, so talking to her at the Pond House is probably what moves it along. Most likely the end of Old Regrets starts it.
A related quest, 'Art of Mercy', opens with 'Talk to Carene' and 'Stop Carene'. Nothing here links it to a No Mercy ending.

All three are properties on the quest script (StendarrProtect, CursedArm, AbMolagCurse). Which ending gives or takes which isn't in these files. Blessing of Stendarr is the same spell Vigilant of Stendarr's script holds, so this quest may take it away rather than give it. The Landing's journal says Molag Bal left his curse on you, which fits the Mark.

These files give the Altar of Molag Bal no hold. Art of Mercy has 'I will go to Stendarr's Beacon and destroy the altar there' and talks of 'the place beneath Stendarr's Beacon', and Auri's patch line says Stendarr's Beacon sits on top of a shrine to Molag Bal.

The quest has three completing endings: one for hunting the witches, one for the Altano steps, one for the Ugly One. Carene's own dialogue comes before the Altano steps, so talking to her rather than killing her probably leads there. The Ugly One's record is 'zzzAoMBossAltanoInner', so that fight is tied to Altano, but the records don't show whether it follows the Altano steps.
'Hunt down the witches' is the only sign they die; ghosts of both appear in The Endless Fall, which fits. Fighting Altano locks nothing: he is back in the next two quests.
